records.content: Import animate from 'animejs'. animate(targets, parameters) returns a JSAnimation. Prefer transform and opacity, bounded targets, and finite playback. Example: animate('.hero-word', { opacity: [0, 1], y: ['.5rem', 0], delay: stagger(70), duration: 500, ease: 'out(3)' });
Import createTimeline from 'animejs'. createTimeline(parameters) returns a Timeline; use .add(target, parameters, position) and labels to coordinate a finite sequence.

Import createScope from 'animejs'. A scope tracks instances and supports mediaQueries. In React, create it inside an effect, return cleanup that calls scope.revert(), and use a reduceMotion media query to set duration: 0 or skip nonessential motion.
Import createDraggable from 'animejs'. createDraggable(target, parameters) returns a Draggable. Preserve keyboard-accessible non-drag controls for essential interactions.
createLayout(root) records layout state. Call layout.record(), make the DOM change, then layout.animate({ duration: 750, ease: 'out(4)' }). Keep layout transitions limited to intentional changes.
Import waapi from 'animejs' and call waapi.animate(targets, parameters) for lightweight basic Web Animations API-powered animation. It has fewer features than JavaScript animate().
Use stagger() with animate for bounded enter sequences. For text, use splitText() only when its generated structure remains accessible; do not make meaning dependent on animation.

patterns.react: Use createScope in useEffect with a root ref; return () => scope.revert(). Put prefers-reduced-motion in scope mediaQueries and skip or use duration 0. Animate opacity and transform only.
patterns.timeline: Use createTimeline({ defaults: { duration: 500, ease: 'out(3)' } }) and .add() finite steps. Avoid infinite decorative timelines by default.
patterns.stagger: Use animate(targets, { opacity: [0,1], y: ['.5rem',0], delay: stagger(70) }); bound targets and disable the sequence for reduced motion.
patterns.scroll: Use a finite, nonessential scroll-triggered effect and retain the final content/state without motion. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
patterns.svg: Animate SVG transforms or opacity where possible; avoid expensive per-frame layout work.
patterns.text: Use staggered opacity/transform for nonessential entrance only. Keep readable text available before and after animation.
patterns.draggable: Use createDraggable and maintain equivalent keyboard/action controls.
patterns.layout: Call record before a deliberate DOM update and animate after it; clean up the owning scope on unmount.
patterns.scope: createScope({ mediaQueries: { reduceMotion: '(prefers-reduced-motion)' } }).add(self => { /* create animations */; return () => {/* cleanup */}; });
patterns.waapi: Use waapi.animate for basic lightweight animations where its supported subset is sufficient.
